title: Implement deployment health check and zero-downtime release gates
summary_zh: 將 Deployment 12 個 route decorators 移至 deployment/router.py；保留 ACG-DEPLOY-EXACT-GATES-20260828 已交付的 release gates，並修正因 include_router() 扁平化差異而新曝露的 path-dedupe 測試工具。

replacement_lineage.reason: V1 從未產出任何 commit；V2 僅為了綁定成功的 OPGAP-DEVTOOL-TARGET-REPO-BRIDGE-V2-20260830 bootstrap 依賴而重新開派，功能範圍不變。

owned: Deployment APIRouter endpoint ownership and dependency injection for 12 deployment domain routes
DeploymentService PKT-001 operator filtering, stage-truth composition, and deployment-diff shaping extraction
BFF composition-root registration and Deployment router ownership test

fix to test_bff_path_dedupe.py route-collection helpers so they recurse into include_router()-mounted sub-routers (a pre-existing gap this extraction was the first to expose, since it moved a path the test enumerates)
not_changing: Reusable deployment exact gates delivered by ACG-DEPLOY-EXACT-GATES-20260828 (scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh gate logic, verify_product_functional_closure.py)
POST /bff/incidents/{id}/rollback-deployment, which stays in main.py because it shares a single generic handler with four other incident/alert routes, not deployment routes
composes_with: existing Deployment plan read-store and PKT-001/PKT-007 contracts

contracts.router_ownership: All 12 deployment-plan / operator-deployment / bff-deployments routes are registered by create_deployment_router; main.py has no remaining inline decorator for these paths (rollback-deployment is the one documented exception).
contracts.composition: main.py imports and includes create_deployment_router using existing BFF ports (read_store, identity/role checks, idempotency, SSE publish/buffers, gov command submission), without a reverse import from deployment/ to main.py.
contracts.service_preservation: DeploymentService retains the established PKT-001 operator plan filtering, stage-truth composition (approval/plan/saga/binding/runtime_fleet), and deployment-diff default/unavailable payload shaping.
contracts.failure_semantics: The router preserves the established authentication-before-validation order and BFF error-envelope semantics.
contracts.route_introspection_fix: test_bff_path_dedupe.py now recursively expands FastAPI 0.139.2's _IncludedRouter.original_router.routes so app-level route enumeration sees routes registered via include_router(), matching how they were visible when declared directly on app.

verification.details: test_deployment_router.py: 2/2. Combined deployment + path-dedupe suite: 82 passed, 2 failed. The 2 failures (test_deprecated_alternate_url_families_return_410_with_headers, test_deprecated_nested_action_families_return_410_with_headers) are pre-existing and unrelated to this change: reproduced identically by stashing this task's diff and re-running against unmodified main.py. ast.parse confirmed main.py, deployment/router.py, and deployment/service.py all parse cleanly after extraction; grep confirmed no dangling references to helper names moved out of main.py.
